# AllyCheck

> Manual accessibility audits and VPAT certification for SaaS companies preparing for the European Accessibility Act, UK Equality Act, and enterprise procurement reviews.

AllyCheck is a manual accessibility auditing agency. We deliver human-led WCAG 2.2 AA audits, VPAT 2.5 documentation, and developer-ready remediation roadmaps that enterprise procurement teams accept.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of AllyCheck's manual accessibility audit and VPAT services.
- [Book a Call](/book): Schedule a free 15-minute call with a senior accessibility auditor.
- [WCAG Audit](/wcag-audit): Manual WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit services for SaaS platforms.
- [VPAT Certification](/vpat-certification): VPAT documentation and accessibility conformance reporting.
- [EAA Compliance](/eaa-compliance): European Accessibility Act readiness for enterprise SaaS.
- [Accessibility Consulting](/accessibility-consulting): Consulting for procurement, remediation, and accessibility programs.
- [WCAG 2.2 AA](/wcag-2-2-aa): WCAG 2.2 AA compliance guidance and manual testing.
- [Screen Reader Testing](/screen-reader-testing): NVDA, VoiceOver, and keyboard accessibility testing.
